note: WAEC Agricultural Science Paper 1 round 1 (Round 16e): the WASSCE syllabus with FRESH angles - scenario stems (streaked maize leaves, deadheart, tomato glut prices, pond draining), Nigerian specifics (groundnut savanna, cocoa belt, West African Dwarf goat, tilapia-free wording) and question-form items - because the near-dup scan checks every item against the JAMB, WAEC and NECO banks INCLUDING the big JAMB Agric banks (039-040) and the 90-item NECO Agric bank. Topics: meaning and scope, soil science, crop production, pests and diseases, animal production, farm tools and machinery, farm management and economics, fisheries, forestry and wildlife.
